name: Impex Rank SEO
author: impexinfotechindia

sections.description:
Impex Rank SEO is a complete SEO plugin built by impexinfotechindia. Every SEO feature is free and fully functional, out of the box, from one branded dashboard — titles and metas, schema, sitemaps, redirects, the 404 monitor, IndexNow, image SEO, the content analyser, the bulk editor and the one-click optimizer. All of it works on unlimited sites with no cap.

The plugin also includes an AI writer that turns a topic into a finished, SEO-ready draft using your own AI provider key. On the free plugin it generates three articles per calendar month; the counter resets on the 1st. Unlimited generation and unattended scheduled publishing (Autopilot) are part of the optional Impex Rank SEO Pro add-on, which is a separate download and is not required for anything else in this plugin.

This plugin does not contact any external server on its own. The AI writer talks only to the AI provider you configure, with your own API key.

Optimize every page

  • Real-time content analysis with a 0–100 score and actionable checks as you write.
  • Live Google preview (SERP snippet) with title & description pixel/character counters.
  • Per-post SEO title, meta description, focus keyword, canonical URL, noindex/nofollow and cornerstone controls.
  • Site-wide title & meta templates with variables (%%title%%, %%sitename%%, %%sep%%, %%excerpt%%, %%category%%, and more) for every post type, taxonomy and archive.

Structured data (JSON-LD)

A clean, connected @graph: Organization / Person, WebSite (with Sitelinks Searchbox), BreadcrumbList, WebPage, Article / BlogPosting / NewsArticle, Product (WooCommerce-aware), FAQPage, and LocalBusiness with address, geo & hours.

Social

  • Open Graph and Twitter/X Cards with per-post title, description and image overrides.
  • Default share image and social profile links (feed into your schema sameAs).

Technical SEO

  • XML sitemaps — index + separate per-post-type & per-taxonomy sitemaps, with images, styled as a branded, readable page. Plus an HTML sitemap shortcode ([impex_html_sitemap]) for visitors.
  • Breadcrumbs — shortcode [impex_breadcrumbs], template tag impexseo_breadcrumbs(), and matching schema.
  • robots.txt editor and llms.txt generator (a manifest for AI assistants & answer engines).
  • Redirect manager — 301/302/307/410, regex support, and automatic redirects when a slug changes.
  • 404 monitor — logs broken URLs so you can fix or redirect them.
  • IndexNow — instantly notify Bing, Yandex and participating engines on publish.
  • Image SEO — automatic alt text for uploads and rendered images.
  • Webmaster verification for Google, Bing, Pinterest, Yandex and Baidu.
  • Page Speed — live PageSpeed Insights scores (mobile & desktop) plus a one-click optimizer that fixes alt text, external links, meta descriptions and focus keywords across your site.

Migrate in one click

Import titles, descriptions, focus keywords, canonicals, social overrides and noindex flags from Yoast SEO or Rank Math — existing Impex Rank SEO data is never overwritten.

External services

This plugin can connect to the following third-party services. Some are optional and only run when you enable the related feature or add an API key.

  1. IndexNow (only when the IndexNow feature is enabled): on publish/update, the URL of the changed content is sent to https://api.indexnow.org/indexnow so participating search engines are notified instantly. Data sent: the content URL and your site’s IndexNow key. Terms of use & privacy: https://www.indexnow.org/terms

  2. Google PageSpeed Insights (only when you click “Check page speed”): the URL being tested is sent to https://www.googleapis.com/pagespeedonline/v5/runPagespeed to return a performance score. Data sent: the page URL (and your optional API key). Terms: https://developers.google.com/terms — Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

  3. AI content providers — your choice, your key (only when you configure the AI Writer and generate a post): the topic/prompt you enter is sent to the provider you selected — Google Gemini (https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com), Groq (https://api.groq.com), OpenRouter (https://openrouter.ai), OpenAI (https://api.openai.com) or Anthropic (https://api.anthropic.com). Data sent: your prompt/topic and settings, using the API key you provide. Review the terms & privacy of the provider you choose, e.g. Gemini: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/terms / https://policies.google.com/privacy ; OpenAI: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use / https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy ; Anthropic: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/consumer-terms / https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy ; Groq: https://groq.com/terms-of-use/ / https://groq.com/privacy-policy/ ; OpenRouter: https://openrouter.ai/terms / https://openrouter.ai/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the impexinfotechindia-seo-suite folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the ZIP via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open Impex Rank SEO in the admin menu and configure Titles, Social, Schema and Sitemap.
  4. Submit your sitemap (/impex-sitemap.xml) to Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools.
sections.faq:
Is it free?

Every SEO tool is free and uncapped, on any number of sites: titles, meta, schema, sitemaps, redirects, the 404 monitor, breadcrumbs, image SEO, the analyzer, the bulk editor and the one-click optimizer.

The one thing with a limit is the AI writer, because generating an article costs real money at the AI provider and takes real server time. The free plugin generates three articles per calendar month. The count resets on the 1st. Everything else is unaffected.

What does the Pro add-on change?

Pro removes the monthly cap on AI articles and enables Autopilot, which processes your topic queue on a schedule without you being at the keyboard. It is a separate plugin you download after purchase and activate with a licence key. You never need it for the SEO features.

Does the plugin phone home?

No. This plugin makes no connection to our servers. The AI writer calls only the AI provider you choose, using the API key you enter, and the optional PageSpeed screen calls Google’s PageSpeed Insights API when you ask it to. If you install the separate Pro add-on, that add-on validates its licence key against wprank.in — but this plugin does not.

Does it work with my theme?

Yes. It outputs standard head tags, schema and sitemaps that work with any theme.

Can I use it alongside Yoast or Rank Math?

We recommend running only one SEO plugin at a time to avoid duplicate tags. Use the built-in importer to migrate, then deactivate the other plugin.

Where is my sitemap?

At yoursite.com/impex-sitemap.xml. If it 404s, visit Settings → Permalinks once to refresh rewrite rules.
sections.changelog:
1.6.2

  • Fixed: “Fix” did nothing on images with an empty alt="". The analyser counted an empty alt as missing while the fixer counted it as present, so the check could never be cleared. Both now agree, and an empty alt is replaced rather than duplicated.
  • Fixed: “Fix” did nothing on an SEO title or meta description that already existed but was the wrong length. Those checks offer a Fix button, but the fixer refused to touch a value that was already set. It now repairs one: over-long descriptions are trimmed on a word boundary, short ones are padded from the content, and a title that is too long or missing its keyword is rewritten.
  • Generated alt text now combines the post title with the focus keyword instead of repeating the title on every image.
  • Generated meta descriptions lead with the focus keyword when the text does not already contain it.
  • Content-level checks (keyword in the opening paragraph, keyword in a subheading, missing subheadings, no list or table, no internal links) now show a Fix button when the Pro add-on is installed, and no button at all when it is not — instead of one that could never work.
  • Fixed the URL-slug check reporting “not applicable” in the classic editor on posts whose slug was perfectly fine.
  • Fixed the keyword fields rendering at half width in the meta box, caused by a CSS class name shared with the settings screens.
  • Renamed the last “SEO Suite” label left in the admin header.

1.6.1

  • Fixed: the SERP preview and score appeared frozen in the block editor. The live preview only redrew after the server replied, and the analysis timer was reset by every editor event — on a busy editor it could be starved indefinitely. The preview now updates instantly as you type, and analysis is guaranteed to run at least every couple of seconds.
  • Reduced editor overhead: the block-editor listener is throttled instead of firing on every store change.
  • Renamed the plugin’s filters to the correct prefix (impexai_pro_active, impexai_free_monthly_generations, impexai_upgrade_url). The previous names still work so existing add-on builds keep functioning.
  • Cleared every remaining coding-standards notice — the plugin now passes Plugin Check and the stricter plugin-review ruleset with zero errors and zero warnings.
  • Related-post lookups no longer use an exclusionary query that scales badly on large sites.

1.6.0

  • Fixed: the “Fix” buttons did nothing. A JavaScript error stopped the result being applied to the screen, so the fix ran on the server but the editor never showed it. Fix now updates the field in front of you and re-scores immediately.
  • Fixed: applying an alt-text or link fix could be silently undone. The fix rewrote the saved post while the editor still held the old content, so the next save reverted it. Fixed content is now pushed back into the editor.
  • New: “Fix” for the SEO title. There was never one — clicking it returned “unknown fix”. It now writes a title built around your focus keyword and trimmed to fit.
  • Fixed: the editor score and the post-list score disagreed. There were two separate scoring engines running different checks. There is now one engine; every screen shows the same number.
  • Scoring is now weighted. Keyword in the title counts for more than “content has an image”. Scores move in ways that make sense.
  • New: secondary keywords are actually analysed. The field existed but nothing read it. Each keyword now gets its own title/description/content/heading breakdown.
  • Keyword matching respects word boundaries — “seo” no longer matches inside “seothersite” and inflates your density.
  • Word counts now work for non-Latin languages. Hindi, Gujarati and similar previously counted as zero words and failed every length check.
  • Keyword density flags stuffing as well as under-use, and says which way to move.
  • New checks: internal links, external links, long paragraphs, lists/tables.
  • Rebuilt the meta box: animated score ring, grouped checks, live updates while you type, and proper loading states.
  • AI writer articles now include a key-takeaways box, a comparison table, an FAQ and a closing call to action, plus internal links to related posts.

1.5.0

  • Renamed to Impex Rank SEO. Same plugin, same settings, same menu location — only the name on screen changed. Nothing needs reconfiguring.
  • The AI writer now generates three articles per calendar month on the free plugin. Every SEO feature remains free and uncapped.
  • New Upgrade screen showing your remaining allowance for the month.
  • Autopilot (unattended scheduled publishing) moved to the optional Pro add-on. The topic queue still works and can be run by hand.
  • A failed generation no longer counts against your monthly allowance.

1.4.2

  • Removed the unused automatic featured-image scaffolding from the AI Writer (generated posts never set a featured image; add one manually in the editor).
  • Removed inactive Video/News sitemap toggles.
  • Fixed: the Setup Wizard and dashboard module grid no longer switch off modules they don’t display.
  • Fixed: one-click “Fix” now reliably fills the meta description and focus keyword.
  • Fixed: Open Graph image alt text, XML sitemap 404 handling, and table-of-contents de-duplication.
  • Fixed a database notice shown on activation, and a deprecated argument in the author dropdown.

1.4.1

  • Changed: every feature is now free and fully functional — removed all usage limits, license checks and Pro gating. The AI writer, Autopilot and one-click optimization work without restriction.
  • Improved: the XML sitemap stylesheet is now a static asset and the HTML sitemap styles are enqueued.
  • Housekeeping: scoped time-limit extensions to the actions that need them; documented external services.

1.4.0

  • New: per-issue “⚡ Fix” buttons in the SEO analysis — resolve a missing meta description, focus keyword, image alt text or unsafe external links one at a time, or “Fix everything” at once.
  • Improved: image alt text and external-link safety are now scored, so one-click optimization visibly raises the SEO score.
  • Improved: SEO score shown as “NN/100” with a branded pill in the posts/pages list.
  • Fixed: JSON-LD schema output hardened against script-context breakout.

1.3.0

  • New: AI Writer (built in) — generate complete, SEO-ready posts from a topic using your own API key (Google Gemini, Groq, OpenRouter, or OpenAI/Claude/custom). Includes an Autopilot topic queue.
  • New: generated posts are auto-filled with SEO title, meta description, focus keyword and FAQ.
  • Merged the former standalone AutoBlogger into the suite — one plugin, one menu.

1.2.0

  • New: Page Speed — real Google PageSpeed Insights scores (mobile & desktop) with Core Web Vitals, on the SEO dashboard and in the post-editor SEO box.
  • New: One-click optimize — fix missing image alt text, mark external links nofollow + new-tab, and fill missing meta descriptions/focus keywords, on a single post or across every page.
  • New: works alongside Impex Rank AI Writer — AI-generated posts arrive pre-optimized.

1.1.0

  • New: branded XML sitemap styling — sitemaps now open as a clean, readable page in the browser.
  • New: [impex_html_sitemap] shortcode for a human-readable HTML sitemap (a second format), grouped by post type and taxonomy.
  • New: AJAX-powered admin — saving settings, adding/deleting redirects, clearing the 404 log and bulk edits no longer reload the page (toast notifications instead).
  • New: keyword density and “keyword in intro” checks in the content analyzer; focus/additional keywords now added to Article schema.
  • Improved: redesigned, fully responsive settings screens (label/control grid) and a properly styled post-editor SEO meta box.

1.0.0

  • Initial release by Impex Infotech.
